applicable_internal_policies.text: For Severity 2 (SEV2), notify the Operations Duty Manager and recovery team within 15 minutes, and the Customer Service Lead within 30 minutes. Risk & Compliance must be included within 30 minutes when integrity, safety or suspected data loss is involved. SEV3 and SEV4 are managed by the assigned service owner during the operating shift; record the handover if unresolved. If any SEV1 threshold develops, start the SEV1 clock at that threshold detection and record the upgrade. Lower severity never permits bypassing evidence preservation.

Escalation begins when an incident meets a severity threshold in POL-INC-001. The analyst records when the threshold was first detected and uses that time for notification deadlines. Escalation is a human action: an assistant may recommend recipients and prepare a draft, but a responsible employee sends the notification. A failed delivery does not satisfy the deadline. Record recipient, channel, sent time and acknowledgement. Use the on-call contact directory; this corpus does not contain phone numbers or personal contact details.

For SEV1 customer-impact incidents, issue the first customer notice within 15 minutes of threshold detection and subsequent updates at least every 30 minutes while impact continues. For SEV2, issue the first notice within 30 minutes and update at least every 60 minutes. If no new facts are available, say investigation continues and give the next update time. A restoration notice does not replace a missing earlier update. Record any missed deadline and its reason in the timeline for review.

The Customer Service Lead owns customer-facing incident messages and coordinates with the incident coordinator. The recovery owner confirms technical facts; Risk & Compliance reviews sensitive integrity statements. Use approved service channels and the status page rather than an analyst's personal account. The message log records author, approval, audience, channel and publication time. An assistant may propose wording, but a human publishes and approves it. Internal escalation under POL-INC-002 and public customer updates are distinct activities with distinct clocks.
